measured: bulk IN bytes after writing one demodulator byte value, then the documented demodulator and FIFO restarts
bench: RTL2832U + R820T-family tuner, 28.8 MHz crystal, behind a USB analyzer with switchable TARGET-A power; no signal source, antenna input sees noise only
candidate_space: page 0, 1, 2 x offset 0x00..=0xFF x value 0x00..=0xFF, except the value the register holds (in the baseline state) when its candidate comes up, logged as a skip; iterated page, offset, value in ascending order with no reordering
excluded: page 3: live readback values (246 of the bit scan's 247 unverified restores, data/step3-scan.jsonl); page 4: its writes at 0x08, 0x10, 0x20, 0xA7 acted like page 0's in the bit scan
restart_order: DEMOD_CTL bit 5 0 then 1; baseline demodulator bytes rewritten; candidate written; USB_EPA_CTL bit 9 1 then 0; candidate read back; measure
restart_order_evidence: data/step3-restart-probe.json: the DEMOD_CTL bit 5 pulse returns every watched demodulator register to its power-on value; demodulator reads and writes stall while held in reset; the FIFO reset changes no demodulator register
settings_held_fixed: documented-only baseline at 2400000 Hz; 4 x 16384 byte bulk transfers queued; first-byte deadline 200 ms after the FIFO reset; on any byte a further 200 ms window
streams_criterion: the further 200 ms window within 20% of 2 x 2400000 bytes/s
line_legend: k: c candidate / s skip (the register's current value) / setup / recovery; p page; o offset; v value; orig the register's value before the candidate (all decimal); rst the restart sequence accepted and read back as intended; in the candidate read back in place after the restart; b bytes (first completion + the further window); lat ms from the end of the FIFO reset to the first byte (null = none within the deadline); bps the further window's bytes/s; s streams; e errors and events (absent when none); w wedged -> power cycle and re-baseline (next line k=recovery)
procedure: read the byte (skip if equal); discard completed transfers; restart sequence with the candidate; read the candidate back; first-byte wait; on bytes the further window; restore the original and verify; on bytes a 50 ms check after the restore; re-check the baseline (reapply, else power-cycle); a chip that stops answering or keeps streaming after the restore is power-cycled
